name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBER SQUAT THRUST
introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. 

Put your hands on the ground and kick your feet backward. Bend your right knee towards your chest and keep your left leg straight, then quickly switch to your left leg. 

Kick your left foot backward, then jump up. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Bend your legs to get your hands on the floor instead of bending your body.
Do the steps of the exercise as quickly as you can.
Too hard for you? You can do this workout without jump.
